scope: All docs/hypotheses Markdown artifacts and directly associated plan-based protocols, qualification and tooling studies. Not a registry of every plan or audit.

rules.unit: One experimental question/protocol sequence per record; protocol and results are artifacts of that record. Separate confirmation/revised tests keep distinct IDs.
rules.questions: Short routing labels; native protocols own hypotheses, thresholds and exact questions.
rules.review_status: result_reviewed means selected result/decision prose was read, not independent execution or full raw-data verification. independently_reproduced requires a separately evidenced reproduction. not_reviewed forbids an inferred verdict.
rules.outcomes: Native result or decision records own verdicts. outcome_source identifies the classification source; synthesis and corrections belong to the linked wiki.
rules.cost: No comparable effort measures extracted. Unknown is not zero. Protocol time caps are not actual elapsed effort.
rules.dispositions: Historical experiment-scoped dispositions, not current assignments. Current plan alone owns priorities.
rules.ontology: The explicit legacy_unversioned_record_ids inventory preserves historical records without speculative backfill. Every record outside that closed inventory must declare the required ontology contract version in its native protocol. Native results and run metadata own observed values and provenance. Historical records are not classified from filenames; absent ontology metadata means unclassified, not a negative scientific result. Structural validation does not certify scientific adequacy.

experiments.question: Does effective information above its own shuffle null separate coordination, or does it separate determinism?
experiments.disposition: REVIEW IS NOT INDEPENDENT: the same agent wrote the protocol, the arm, the runner and this result in one session, which is exactly the structural problem the current plan's debt 3 names. Read result_reviewed as 'the result prose was read', per the register's own rule, not as reproduction. Commissioned by the 2026-09-05 prose-vs-code audit, which argued that EI-above-shuffle-null reads determinism rather than coordination and advised holding the queued Q1-006 re-run. Built the deterministic-independent arm the slot family lacked: derived_phase with its shared period -- which equals the population size -- replaced by a period each unit takes from its own need, changing nothing else. Nulls committed before the protocol named a threshold, and the calibration script structurally refuses to compute an observed value at all, which is stronger than Q1-009's freeze. Analyst's prediction recorded in the protocol and FALSIFIED. G-A FAIL (+0.0670 above null against a frozen bar of 0.1217, two sd of its own measured null). G-B PASS (0.7287 relative satisfaction against a ceiling of 0.80), which is what makes the failure informative: removing the shared period really did cost 27 percent of need-satisfaction on a duty cycle matched to 4.3 percent, so the arm is a genuine uncoordinated control and the statistic correctly declined to report it as structured. On the slot the ordering is coordinated +6.3 null sd, deterministic-independent +1.65, independent draw ~0. THE AUDIT'S ADVICE AGAINST THE Q1-006 RE-RUN IS WITHDRAWN, not softened; Q1-006 is on this family. THREE THINGS STAND. The response is graded rather than binary: the deterministic-independent arm still reaches 39 percent of the coordinated arm's effect, so 'essentially nothing where it is absent' overstates it. The commons was NOT re-run and is untouched: Q1-009's own table puts the uncoordinated frozen arm at +0.198, which is 5.4 null sd, against random's +0.006, so Q1-009's 'on two families' clause remains unsupported on the commons. And the response across deterministic arms is non-monotonic -- constant_phase -0.118 (Q1-009 result.json; -0.085 in its later followup.json, below its null in both) and private_period_primes -0.155 both sit below their own nulls, plausibly from duty-driven null inflation, untested. Recorded as debt 4 in the current plan. Two apparatus defects were found before the run by checking exhaustively where a sample had passed: the first robustness arm's periods shared a cycle of exactly 120, the horizon, at seed 6; and the primary arm is inadmissible on 7 of 1600 seeds, excluded from every arm including derived_phase so the needs distribution stays matched. Scope: one family, one coarse-graining, 1593 seeds, not a clause-2 test, nothing blind.
experiments.headline: The suspicion that the headline statistic reads determinism rather than coordination was tested on the slot family and FAILED its own frozen gate: coordinated +6.3 null sd, deterministic-but-independent +1.65, independent draw ~0. It still holds unexplained on the commons, where an uncoordinated arm sits 5.4 null sd up.

experiments.question: Does a coarse-grained description of these specimens carry causal structure the micro description does not, and does an independent goal-free measure agree?
experiments.disposition: CORRECTED 2026-09-05 after a code review of this experiment's own implementation found eight defects, each confirmed by execution. Two were serious: the empowerment sampler was seeded from Python hash(), salted per process, so every empowerment number was unreproducible while the record claimed the opposite; and the slot outcome coding divided by the larger of the counterfactual pair, coupling the two intervention arms, forcing p(middle bucket | do not act) to exactly 0.000 in all three arms, and putting slot and commons on different scales. Two more forced interventions outside the system's own action space. Rerun on corrected code. EVERY EFFECTIVE-INFORMATION AND EMERGENCE VALUE IS UNCHANGED, which is the evidence the defects were confined to the empowerment path. G1 pass (+0.589 vs 0.10). G2 pass (+0.589 vs 0.05) BUT HOLLOW AND NOT CLAIMED: the commons none arm visits 1 micro state of 32, all twelve subunits acting on 100 percent of ticks. G3 now PASSES (+0.053 vs 0.05, was +0.028 fail on defective code), so its ordering must be read rather than withheld. NO CAUSAL EMERGENCE: EI(macro) minus EI(micro) is negative in every non-degenerate arm on both specimens and outside null noise (commons live -0.133, frozen -0.321, slot derived_phase -0.112). The coarse-grained description carries strictly LESS causal structure than the micro one. Scope is one coarse-graining; the partition was not retuned. WHAT DISCRIMINATES: EI-micro above its own shuffle null, on both families - commons live +0.589 vs frozen +0.198; slot derived_phase +0.168 vs matched-random -0.040 vs constant_phase -0.118. Raw EI ranks the arms WRONGLY (uncoordinated frozen highest at 1.006), so the null subtraction is load-bearing. On the slot the matched-independent arm sits AT its null, the clause-2 shape; recorded as suggestive, NOT a clause-2 claim. EMPOWERMENT IS CONFOUNDED WITH IDLENESS: the ordering (constant_phase 0.0605 > derived_phase 0.0123 > random_attempt 0.0074) tracks channel idle fraction exactly (90.0, 49.2, 41.0 percent). What the estimator measures is unused capacity available to a unilateral actor, not agency, so the disagreement with effective information is weak evidence for the founding spec's 'systematically diverge' and better evidence that the estimator is not yet measuring agency on this family. Commons stays at ~0 and that comparison is now legitimate. Predictions: 1 of 4 held, and the three failures now fail on corrected code rather than being unreadable. None of the eight defects was caught by the tests written alongside the original code; each now has a regression test. FOLLOW-UP 2026-09-05, post-hoc over the same configuration, not a re-scoring of any frozen gate. The commons gained the matched-independent arm it lacked: each subunit draws independently at that seed's own live draw rate, three original arms bit-identical. It scores +0.006 above its null against live's +0.589, so a matched-independent population sits AT its null on the commons as well as on the slot (random_attempt +0.024 vs derived_phase +0.167). The statistic therefore reports structure where coordination is present and essentially nothing where it is absent, on TWO families, now against a real control rather than a degenerate floor -- the clause-2 shape, still explicitly not a clause-2 claim. Empowerment's intervention was widened to a contiguous block of ten ticks with eight buckets after the original coding was found to sit below its own effect size; capacities rose 10-30x and the gate passes at 0.690, but the ordering still tracks channel idle fraction arm for arm (constant_phase 90.0% idle scores 1.0000, at the one-bit ceiling; derived_phase 49.2% scores 0.4457; random_attempt 41.0% scores 0.3100), and on the commons the matched-independent arm has the HIGHEST empowerment. The resolution fix worked and did not rescue the measure: empowerment as operationalized measures unused capacity available to a unilateral actor, which is now measured rather than suspected. Emergence unchanged and still negative everywhere, including the new arm.
experiments.headline: No causal emergence on either specimen: the coarse-grained description carries strictly LESS effective information than the micro one it was built from, in every non-degenerate arm. A later review found eight defects in this experiment's own code; every effective-information value survived, every empowerment value moved.

experiments.question: Is the clause-2 floor caused by the substrate's congestion coupling?
experiments.disposition: DIAGNOSIS_WRONG, the disposition this was run for. Congestion refuted: removing the 1/k-squared coupling entirely RAISED the statistic, 0.108 to 0.134. A replacement saturation hypothesis was tested and also refuted (0.74 pre-saturation). The confirmed cause is the statistic itself: mean absolute correlation of INDEPENDENT series is positive at finite sample, and pure gaussian noise with no substrate scores 0.1218 at horizon 120, tracking sqrt(2/(pi(n-2))) across a 24x horizon range. Consequences: Q1-006's 0.10 ceiling was set BELOW that null so no independent process could have passed it and its clause-2 failure measured an unachievable gate, not the substrate; Q1-007 removed a coupling that was never the cause; and this protocol froze its own unachievable 0.05 gate, the same error inside the experiment designed to catch it. What survives and is strengthened: coordinated 0.284 against a measured null of ~0.12 is a real 2.4x separation. Clause 2 is neither met nor failed - it has not been validly tested. Both prior records carry superseding notes.
experiments.headline: The statistic's floor is its own finite-sample null, about 0.12 at this horizon and entity count — not any property of the substrate. This experiment then committed the same below-null gate error it was written to catch.

experiments.question: Does removing the substrate's congestion coupling let the relation statistic meet clause 2?
experiments.disposition: The correction removed essentially nothing: derived 0.2838 to 0.2826, random 0.1078 to 0.1076. G1 and G2 pass as before, G3 still fails at 0.1076 against 0.10. Cause is a protocol design defect of mine, visible in the substrate definition all along - the coupling is 1/k squared and I regressed on k, so a linear control against a quadratic-inverse effect captures almost none of it. Deliberately did NOT immediately run the 1/k squared version: it would likely pass and its justification is derivable without reference to any result, but it would be the fourth consecutive one-more-fix aimed at a single 0.008 overshoot, and the sequence has been converging on a threshold rather than on a question. Stopping the chase is the finding. What stands after seven runs: relation IS measurable (0.283 vs 0.108, 0.175 margin, reproduced twice), the two failure modes are mechanically understood, and the residual obstacle is substrate physics rather than the statistic. The live question is now whether to qualify on a substrate whose own physics sets a non-zero floor, or move to one where independent entities are genuinely independent in outcome - a design decision, not another statistic.
experiments.headline: The congestion explanation this experiment was built on is refuted: removing the coupling entirely RAISES the statistic instead of lowering it. Lane stopped.

experiments.question: Can a statistic measure whether entity differences are related, rather than merely present?
experiments.disposition: Mean absolute off-diagonal residual correlation scores coordinated 0.284, matched-random 0.108, uniform 0.000. G1 signal passes and G2 sufficiency passes with a 0.176 margin - the gate every previous statistic failed, so relation IS measurable and the line from Q1-003 is not exhausted. G3 fails by 0.008 (random 0.108 against a frozen ceiling of 0.10), which is exactly the contamination the protocol named in advance: congestion makes independent entities non-independent in outcome, since k simultaneous attempters each receive 1/k squared, and removing the cross-entity mean does not remove a term nonlinear in k. Not rounded away; clause 2 is not claimable and the instrument remains unqualified, for the first time for a reason that is small, specific and mechanically understood. Next step is a correction rather than a new idea: regress out the population attempt count before taking pairwise correlation.
experiments.headline: Coordinated scored 0.284 against matched-random 0.108. The clause-2 gate was frozen at 0.10 — BELOW the statistic's own finite-sample null — so no independent process could ever have passed it, and the recorded failure measured an unachievable gate.

experiments.question: Does the idiosyncratic fraction measure coordination, or only differentiation?
experiments.disposition: G1 necessity passes (coordinated 0.934, uniform 0.000) but G2 sufficiency fails with margin -0.014 against a required +0.20: a matched independent random population scores HIGHER (0.948) than the coordinated one. The statistic measures differentiation, not coordination, so an instrument using it would report structure in a random population, which clause 2 forbids. Persistence fails the same test (0.921 vs 0.877). Predicted in advance against my own proposed statistic. Secondary and more important: random_attempt reaches 0.375 need satisfaction against derived_phase 0.438, so C2-001 - which headlined derived against level_only at 0.000 - was missing a random control and its effect is 17% relative rather than total. Same defect class as C1-001 best-constant control, twice in one session. C2 narrowed accordingly. The rival source is now named and a matched-randomness control should be standing rather than per-experiment.
experiments.headline: The advantage over matched randomness is about 17% relative, not the total effect an earlier comparison implied: matched random reaches 0.375 against derived phase's 0.438. Most of the benefit is desynchronization, which randomness supplies free.

experiments.question: Does the frozen detector, unchanged, separate a differentiated population from an active undifferentiated one on a family it was not built for?
experiments.disposition: Clause 4 satisfied by construction: the detector was authored against a divisible commons and run unchanged on an indivisible slot with a phase-based mechanism and a collision failure mode. It separated a differentiated population (persistence 0.921) from an active undifferentiated one (0.698) in the predicted direction. But the frozen prediction said low under the negative arm and 0.698 is not low - Q1-003's negative scored 0.062 - so the flagged risk partly materialised and the statistic is substantially measuring temporal extent rather than differentiation. Protocol defect recorded rather than exploited: it froze a direction but no numeric threshold, so the 0.1 gap cutoff is post-hoc and is not treated as a passed gate. Instrument NOT declared qualified outright; status is directional transfer on a statistic partly measuring the wrong thing. The variance-fraction inversion from Q1-003 replicates exactly on this second family (constant 1.000 vs derived 0.067), which strengthens that finding considerably.
experiments.headline: The instrument recovered an authored coordination on a second family it was not built for — a directional pass, carrying a caveat about the statistic it leans on.

experiments.question: How load-bearing is the derivation rule that turns a subunit's own goal into a phase?
experiments.disposition: Landed in the frozen partial band (44.4% within 90% of authored), and reporting the distribution rather than rounding it produced the actual result: neither plateau nor ridge, but exact bimodality. The offset b does nothing (a constant before a modulo rotates all phases uniformly). Performance is a function of gcd(a, P) alone with no residual variation inside a class - 0.438 for coprime, 0.112 at gcd 2, 0.013 at gcd 5, 0.000 at gcd 10, matching 10/5/2/1 available phases. Unifies with C2-001: the rule affects performance only through how many of the environment's distinct values it preserves. Rule discovery is therefore a condition to satisfy, not a search problem. Partly clears the standing worry that my authored choices carry the mechanisms: a=1 is joint best tied with 19 other coprime members, so it was in the optimal class by construction rather than by judgement, though I could have violated the condition by picking a=2. Untested: a prime period, where the bimodality should vanish.
experiments.headline: The derivation rule matters only through how many distinct phases it preserves, which is one line of algebra about gcd(a, P) rather than an empirical discovery.

experiments.question: Can the distinguishing information that breaks symmetry come from the environment's own heterogeneity rather than from a designer assigning labels?
experiments.disposition: All three gates pass: precondition P0 (authored beats level-only 8/8, explicitly not a finding since it re-derives TDMA), G1 (derived beats level-only 8/8 at widest spread), G2 (derived monotonic in need spread). Mechanism confirmed rather than assumed: performance tracks the number of distinct phases the environment supplies, rising 1.0 to 6.6 as spread widens, and at zero spread every subunit derives the same phase, collides forever and scores exactly 0.000 as predicted. Real limit recorded: the environment supplied the values but the derivation rule is authored, so the claim is that environmental heterogeneity can substitute for designer-assigned identity GIVEN a rule, not that labels emerge. Fourth consecutive experiment where an authored choice of mine carried the mechanism. Does not change C1's status; C2 was admitted as a separate conjecture.
experiments.headline: Environmental heterogeneity can substitute for designer-assigned identity: satisfaction rises 0.000 to 0.438 as need spread widens, tracking distinct phases 1.0 to 6.6. Both the derivation rule and the period, which equals the population size, are still authored.

experiments.question: Does a shared-scalar coordination signal transfer from a divisible renewable resource to an indivisible contended slot?
experiments.disposition: The specimen failed its own pre-declared validity gate across three attempts (0 wins of 8 in every configuration), so the detector was never run, never read and never modified, and clause 4 of the completion condition remains unmet. Stopped at the declared retune budget rather than at the point of running out of ideas. The failure is structural and is the finding: a scalar threshold read identically by every subunit can only gate them together, never stagger them, so it coordinates a divisible renewable stock and cannot allocate an indivisible slot - it is common-mode by construction. Cognitive glue as implemented is a price mechanism and price mechanisms need a divisible good, so C1-001 now looks closer to a rediscovery of why adaptive prices beat fixed ones on a commons than to evidence of a general principle. C1 stays supported-on-one-family and this failure is recorded against it. Extending to symmetry-breaking primitives that carry phase or identity is a separate conjecture with its own refuter, not a rescue of C1.
experiments.headline: The same mechanism could not coordinate an indivisible slot at all. A shared scalar every subunit reads identically is common-mode by construction: it can gate a population together but never stagger it, so C1 is a price mechanism and needs a divisible good.

experiments.question: Can a candidate family with a latent shared regressor separate a shared quantity that gates decisions from one that only constrains outcomes?
experiments.disposition: Persistence distinguishes in the predicted direction (live 0.827 vs none 0.062), closing the structural gap Q1-002 named. Does NOT qualify the instrument: clause 4 of the charter completion condition fails because the family, its estimator and its statistics were authored while holding the specimen's ground truth - the same defect P15 recorded, and worse to repeat knowingly. Development case, not qualification. The naive adequacy statistic (shared-variance fraction) is a trap: it distinguishes in the WRONG direction, scoring the collapsed system 1.000 against the coordinated 0.586, because after collapse every subunit draws zero and residuals become identical - uniformity read as coordination. Caught only because the protocol froze both statistics and their predicted directions before implementation.
experiments.headline: A candidate family carrying a latent shared regressor closes the gap — but the record says plainly it does not qualify the instrument, because its author wrote it knowing the answer.

experiments.question: Is Q1-001's null caused by the authored observation contract, or by the candidate family?
experiments.disposition: None of three observation contracts distinguishes the coordinated from the uncoordinated run at the disposition level. Rules out the cheap explanation for Q1-001: the coupling is not hidden by packaging, it is unrepresentable in repeated_entity_dynamics, which fits each entity under a shared local law. Contract B (attempted, served) was predicted most likely to succeed and was worst - it made the series less affine and the instrument abstained on both, showing legibility to an analyst and representability in a candidate family are different properties. Consequence: a shared packaging contract is worth building and will not buy coordination detection; those are two separate units of work.
experiments.headline: The gap is not how the cases are packaged; it is what the model family can say. Repackaging changes nothing.

experiments.question: Can the analytic instrument recover an authored coordination it was not told about, and not report it where it is absent?
experiments.disposition: Same disposition for a coordinated and an uncoordinated run of the same system: shared_local_affine, candidate, passive_sufficient true on both. Worse than a tie - the instrument affirms passive sufficiency on a system whose behaviour is mediated by a shared quantity outside every entity. Clause 1 of the charter completion condition fails, so no construction claim in this programme is verified. Two positives: the proposal path accepted a fifth system it was not written for, confirming the case-specificity is in the packer not the proposer, and the vague open-endedness frontier is replaced by a specific gap - repeated_entity_dynamics has no candidate expressing dependence on an exogenous shared quantity.
experiments.headline: Handed a matched pair differing only in whether a coordinating signal was present, the instrument returned the SAME disposition for both. The candidate family has no way to express dependence on a shared quantity, so coordination is unrepresentable rather than merely undetected.

experiments.question: Does a shared scarcity signal have to track scarcity, or does the best fixed threshold coordinate as well?
experiments.disposition: All three frozen gates passed (G1 8/8, G2 8/8, G3 monotonic), and the conclusion survives a stronger control than the frozen one: adaptive 1.000 vs best fixed threshold 0.500. But the protocol's stated justification for its negative control is measured false - the frozen level (live time-average, ~0.51) sits below the 0.60-0.85 band where any constant works, so the recorded 0.000-to-1.000 effect size overstates. Restated effect: tracking roughly doubles satisfaction over the best constant. Constructive, authored, white-box, one family; not a discovery and not a claim about composition in general.
experiments.headline: A shared scarcity signal beat the best fixed threshold on a renewable commons, 1.000 against 0.500 over 8 seeds — but the pre-registered control was weaker than claimed, and the effect size was revised down in the record.

experiments.question: Can a modest type-directed proposal layer produce decision-relevant relational candidates or honest abstention across opaque archived systems without task labels?
experiments.disposition: Seam passes: both held cases (P13, P14) and, after correcting a P12 evaluator disposition-rule error, both development cases (P10, P12) matched native dispositions with all leakage/lineage/package checks passing. Capability claim relational_proposal_and_abstention is NOT established: its frozen operating condition 'no case-specific code paths' was violated on both sides of the freeze (four hand-written per-case proposers behind a dispatch, fed by four hand-written per-case packers that assign the dispatch key), and cross-case generality is measured at zero (12/12 refusals, 2026-09-04 probe). The held-system decision gate is therefore not cleanly earned; no discovery, generalization, or competence claim.
experiments.headline: The freeze/reveal/audit machinery works end to end, but the capability it was meant to reward does not exist: applying all four proposers to all four cases gives an empty off-diagonal, so proposal generality measured zero.
